import copy
import numpy as np
def _family(n):
    i = np.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=float)
    A = np.zeros((n, n))
    A[np.diag_indices(n)] = np.log(99.0 + i)
    off = 0.19*np.sin(0.73*i[:-1]) + 0.004*np.cos(0.41*i[:-1])
    A[np.arange(n-1), np.arange(1, n)] = off
    A[np.arange(1, n), np.arange(n-1)] = off
    return A
def _sketch(s, n, zeta, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    S = np.zeros((s, n))
    for col in range(n):
        rows = rng.choice(s, zeta, replace=False)
        signs = 2*rng.integers(0, 2, zeta) - 1
        S[rows, col] = signs / np.sqrt(zeta)
    return S
def _sketch_orthonormal(S, V):
    _, R = np.linalg.qr(S @ V)
    d = np.sign(np.diag(R))
    d[d == 0.0] = 1.0
    return np.linalg.solve((d[:, None]*R).T, V.T).T

state = (A, S, Vt, Q, W, T)
assert np.allclose(sketched_block_expansion(copy.deepcopy(state)), target)

import copy
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import eigh
def _family(n):
    i = np.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=float)
    A = np.zeros((n, n))
    A[np.diag_indices(n)] = np.log(99.0 + i)
    off = 0.19*np.sin(0.73*i[:-1]) + 0.004*np.cos(0.41*i[:-1])
    A[np.arange(n-1), np.arange(1, n)] = off
    A[np.arange(1, n), np.arange(n-1)] = off
    return A
def _sketch(s, n, zeta, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    S = np.zeros((s, n))
    for col in range(n):
        rows = rng.choice(s, zeta, replace=False)
        signs = 2*rng.integers(0, 2, zeta) - 1
        S[rows, col] = signs / np.sqrt(zeta)
    return S
def _extraction(A, S, V, k, flip=()):
    Qs, Rf = np.linalg.qr(S @ V)
    d = np.sign(np.diag(Rf))
    Vt = np.linalg.solve((d[:, None]*Rf).T, V.T).T
    Q = S @ Vt
    W = A @ Vt
    vals, vecs = eigh(Vt.T @ W, Vt.T @ Vt)
    theta, Y = vals[:k].copy(), vecs[:, :k].copy()
    U = Vt @ Y
    for c in range(k):
        nz = np.flatnonzero(np.abs(U[:, c]) > 1e-15)
        if nz.size and U[nz[0], c] < 0.0:
            U[:, c] *= -1.0
            Y[:, c] *= -1.0
    for c in flip:
        U[:, c] *= -1.0
        Y[:, c] *= -1.0
    R = W @ Y - U * theta[None, :]
    return (A, S, Vt, Q, W, theta, Y, U, R)
n = 24
A = _family(n)
S = _sketch(45, n, 4, 2026)
state = _extraction(A, S, np.random.default_rng(9).standard_normal((n, 9)), 3)
assert np.allclose(restart_rotation(copy.deepcopy(state)), target)

    A[np.diag_indices(n)] = np.log(99.0 + i)
    off = 0.19*np.sin(0.73*i[:-1]) + 0.004*np.cos(0.41*i[:-1])
    A[np.arange(n-1), np.arange(1, n)] = off
    A[np.arange(1, n), np.arange(n-1)] = off
    return A
def _sketch(s, n, zeta, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    S = np.zeros((s, n))
    for col in range(n):
        rows = rng.choice(s, zeta, replace=False)
        signs = 2*rng.integers(0, 2, zeta) - 1
        S[rows, col] = signs / np.sqrt(zeta)
    return S
def _restarted_state(n, s, zeta, seed, t_seed):
    A = _family(n)
    S = _sketch(s, n, zeta, seed)
    V0 = np.random.default_rng(t_seed).standard_normal((n, 3))
    Vt, _ = np.linalg.qr(V0)
    Q = S @ Vt
    W = A @ Vt
    T = np.random.default_rng(t_seed + 100).standard_normal((n, 3))
    return (A, S, Vt, Q, W, T)
n = 24
A = _family(n)
S = _sketch(45, n, 4, 2026)
V9, _ = np.linalg.qr(np.random.default_rng(41).standard_normal((n, 9)))
_, Y9 = np.linalg.eigh(V9.T @ A @ V9)
V3 = V9 @ Y9[:, :3]
Q3 = S @ V3
T1 = np.random.default_rng(43).standard_normal((n, 3))
C1 = Q3.T @ (S @ T1)
Tp = T1 - V3 @ C1
_, r = np.linalg.qr(S @ Tp)
r = np.sign(np.diag(r))[:, None] * r
Vt = np.column_stack((V3, np.linalg.solve(r.T, Tp.T).T))
Q = S @ Vt
W = A @ Vt
T = np.random.default_rng(42).standard_normal((n, 3))
state = (A, S, Vt, Q, W, T)
assert np.allclose(post_restart_expansion(copy.deepcopy(state)), target)
